title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
name_bilingual: 装备生产全解锁 / Unlock All Equipment Production
source_gateway_semantics: Follow *0x00C394C8, guard the object identity, then fill 49 words at object+0x65DC with 0xFFFFFFFF. The PPC conversion bypasses only the corresponding valid-ID unlock-bit failure branch and does not mutate save/runtime tables.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Equipment - Production Unlock

preimages.meaning: 中文：装备 ID 已通过 0xFFFF/0x5FD 边界检查后，原逻辑在解锁位为 0 时返回失败；补丁仅取消这条失败分支。 / English: After the equipment ID passes the 0xFFFF/0x5FD bounds checks, the original branch rejects a clear unlock bit; the patch removes only that rejection.

anchors.meaning: 中文：无效装备 ID 0xFFFF 的原生边界检查，保持不变。 / English: Native invalid-equipment-ID 0xFFFF guard, left unchanged.
中文：最大有效装备 ID 0x5FC 的原生上界检查，保持不变。 / English: Native upper bound limiting valid equipment IDs to 0x5FC, left unchanged.
中文：从 PPC 解锁位表读取对应 32 位字。 / English: Loads the corresponding 32-bit word from the PPC unlock-bit table.
中文：提取装备 ID 对应的单个解锁位。 / English: Extracts the single unlock bit for the equipment ID.
中文：原生失败返回 0，仍供无效 ID 路径使用。 / English: Native false return, retained for invalid-ID paths.
中文：PPC 包装器把角色子对象加到解锁表基址；与 3DS root+0x18+0x65C4 对应。 / English: PPC wrapper advances the character subobject to the unlock table, matching the 3DS root+0x18+0x65C4 layout.

known_risks: 中文：本包不向存档写入 49 个全 1 字，而是在每次读取时令所有有效装备 ID 通过解锁位判定；因此关闭后会恢复原进度，不会永久解锁。 / English: This pack does not write forty-nine all-one words into the save/runtime object; it makes every valid equipment ID pass the unlock-bit read, so disabling it restores normal progression without permanent unlocks.

中文：它只负责生产列表的进度解锁，不提供材料或金钱，也不解锁商店库存、任务、配方以外的系统；“无需材料”包已经包含同一解锁补丁，两者不要同时启用。 / English: It only removes progression gating from equipment production; it grants neither materials nor money and does not unlock shops, quests, or unrelated systems. The No Materials pack already includes the same unlock patch, so do not enable both.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把外部 3DS Gateway“装备生产全解锁”的 49 字解锁位表写入语义，转换为 JP v96 原生 PPC 解锁位读取的一条窄范围失败分支旁路；2026-08-11 实机反馈功能正常且无异常，默认关闭，Runtime Verified。 / English: Converts the external 3DS Gateway Unlock All Equipment Production cheat's forty-nine-word unlock-table write into a narrow bypass of the native JP-v96 PPC unlock-bit failure branch; gameplay feedback on 2026-08-11 confirmed the intended behavior with no anomaly. Disabled by default; Runtime Verified.
